title: luzula campestris subsp. alpestris
intro: Luzula campestris subsp. alpestris, commonly known as Alpine Wood-rush, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Juncaceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and respiratory infections, due to its health benefits. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms associated with inflammation and infections. The bioactive constituents of Luzula campestris subsp. alpestris include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
